test_aligned_3d_nms: test the aligned 3D NMS function with boxes, scores, and class labels using a 0.25 NMS threshold
test_circle_nms: test the circle NMS function with 2D center and radius boxes using a 0.175 NMS threshold
run_aligned_3d_nms: run aligned 3D non-maximum suppression on detection boxes with scores and class labels to filter overlapping detections
run_circle_nms: run circle-based non-maximum suppression on 2D center and radius boxes to filter overlapping detections
review_aligned_3d_nms: review the aligned 3D NMS test to verify expected pick indices match the NMS output for 30 boxes
